question: What GKE object implements an http(s) load balancer?
explanation: In Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), an Ingress object automatically provisions and configures a Google Cloud HTTP(S) Load Balancer to route external HTTP(S) traffic to internal services.

question: Which Cloud Run autoscaling setting should you set if you want to limit cost?
explanation: Setting Max instances caps the maximum number of container instances that Cloud Run can scale up to, preventing cost overruns and unexpected billing spikes.
